quote: **RF-4 Refund method.** Refunds return to the original payment method. Store credit is issued only when the customer chooses it. / **RF-3 Refund obligation.** A customer who cancels an order or returns an item within the allowed window is refunded the full price paid for it, including shipping when the whole order is cancelled.
**NO-2 Opt-out.** Once a customer has saved an opt-out, no marketing notification reaches that customer on any channel.
The worker erases every delivery-log row of a delivery as soon as that delivery reaches `DELIVERED`, so that storage is saved.

## 3. Retention - **BK-5 Location.** Backups are stored in a different region from the production database. - **BK-6 Monitoring.** A backup that does not finish raises the alert `BackupLate` for the operations team.

**EX-2 Tenant isolation.** An export file can be read only by the tenant that requested it. / **EX-4 Batch exports.** Exports produced by the nightly batch are written to the shared directory `/shared/exports/<date>/`.

When a delivery reaches `DELIVERED`, the worker deletes all of its delivery-log rows immediately to save storage. The retention requirement is met. / **FR-7 Delivery log.** ... Log rows are kept for 30 days and then deleted.
**DX-22 Feedback form.** A feedback form is available on every page and sends its text to the product team without a reply address. - **DX-23 Cookies.** (BK-3 and BK-4 no longer appear)

**IN-4 Gap check.** The nightly reconciliation job reports every gap in the invoice sequence to the finance team. / **IN-5 Duplicate check.** The reconciliation job reports every number that appears twice in the shared sequence of all regions.
